name.fr-FR: Institutions liturgiques, tome II : La Liturgie du XVIIe au XIXe siècle
name.en-US: Liturgical Institutions, Volume II: The Liturgy from the 17th to the 19th Century
name.pt-BR: Instituições litúrgicas, tomo II: A Liturgia do século XVII ao XIX

description.fr-FR: Deuxième volume de la seconde édition : préface, puis la suite de l’histoire de la Liturgie (chapitres XVII-XXIV) : les liturgies néo-gallicanes du XVIIe et du XVIIIe siècle, le rétablissement de la Liturgie romaine au XIXe siècle ; avec l’appendice et l’addition.
description.en-US: Second volume of the second edition: preface, then the rest of the history of the Liturgy (chapters XVII-XXIV): the neo-Gallican liturgies of the 17th and 18th centuries and the restoration of the Roman Liturgy in the 19th; with the appendix and the addition.
description.pt-BR: Segundo volume da segunda edição: prefácio e a continuação da história da Liturgia (capítulos XVII-XXIV): as liturgias neogalicanas dos séculos XVII e XVIII e o restabelecimento da Liturgia romana no século XIX; com o apêndice e o adendo.

fr-FR.editor: Société générale de librairie catholique, Victor Palmé (Paris)
